**kerneless version(s) affected**: x.y.z

<!-- utcet.h (time conversion), dsk_reader.h (DSK reading), the Python bindings, or the build/install. -->

**Description**
<!-- A clear and concise description of the problem. -->

<!-- The exact command or code needed to reproduce the problem.

**Environment**
<!-- OS, compiler, Python version, and — if comparing against NAIF SPICE —
     your spiceypy or cspice version. -->

**Possible Solution**
<!--- Optional: only if you have suggestions on a fix/reason for the bug -->

**Additional context**
<!-- Optional: any other context about the problem: error output, stack trace, etc.
